# Vendored ElevenLabs browser client

- Package: `@elevenlabs/client`
- Version: `1.23.0`
- File: `elevenlabs-client-1.23.0.iife.js` (`dist/lib.iife.js` from the
  published npm package)
- npm package SHA-1: `7b4713a17c4b165a2f7398a1e1344af1ca9a022f`
- Bundle SHA-256: `b6adb12bd5df649af3ce3ac9205fd0e7d1c099513481c58bd1990f2d50903204`

The bundle is pinned and served by Omarvis so the remote page does not fetch
third-party executable code at call time. It does not make conversations
offline: the browser still connects to ElevenLabs over WebRTC.
